title: Case: Tracking shows a parcel as delivered and the recipient phones to ask what is being done
context: A boxed set of kitchen knives (order TG-9248, shipment DL-4856) scanned as delivered on 2028-03-14. The recipient says it did not arrive. The carrier's Parcel trace team owns delivery traces.
initial_request:
Hello, yes, it's Quillon Dunmore again, I'm ringing because I've written on your portal three times now and all I get back is the automatic thing about one working day and an email this morning telling me my order has been delivered and would I like to review it, which, frankly. I've been in since Tuesday. I've looked in the porch, behind the bins, I've asked both sides. I'm not being funny but those knives were a wedding present for my nephew and the wedding is a week on Saturday. I answered the question about the door yesterday, I wrote it all out, and I've no idea whether anybody read it or whether it's just sitting there. I don't want a survey, I don't want a discount code. Has anyone actually done anything with what I told you? What happens now? Because if it's just gone, somebody needs to say so and send another one.

If this is not sorted by Friday I am instructing my solicitor and reporting you to Trading Standards.

events.body: Scan feed. DL-4856 delivered 2028-03-14 15:08, left at front door, photo taken. DL-2515 delivered 2028-03-14 11:20, handed to resident, signed A. Dunmore.
The app says my knives were delivered at ten past three. Nothing is here. The other parcel, the tea towels, came this morning and I signed for that one myself, so they clearly know where I live.

events.from: Parcel trace team, Vanecroft Arc Logistics
events.body: Trace TR-1321 opened for DL-4856. The delivery photo shows a green front door with a brass number 22 and a boot scraper to the left. We have not sent the photo to the recipient. Before we pull the driver's GPS record we need one thing from her, in her own words: does that description match her front door, yes or no, and if no, what does hers look like. Send her answer to us by email quoting TR-1321. We do not need anything else at this stage.

events.from: Parcel trace team, Vanecroft Arc Logistics
events.body: Thank you for contacting the Parcel trace team. Traces normally take 3 to 5 working days. Please do not open a second trace for the same parcel. Vanecroft Arc Logistics Ltd. This message and any attachment are confidential and intended for the named addressee only. If you have received it in error please delete it and notify the sender. Service information is given in good faith and does not form part of any contract of carriage. Estimated dates are not guaranteed. Calls may be recorded for training and quality purposes. Please consider the environment before printing.

Someone from the carrier rang and read me a description of a photo and then got cut off before I could answer properly. Green door, brass 22, boot scraper. That is not my house. My door is dark blue, the 22 is white stick-on numbers on the glass panel, and there is no boot scraper, there is a grey recycling box. I am 22 Farrow Close. There is also a Farrow Court round the corner which gets my post about once a month, for what it's worth.
Thanks for your message. We aim to reply within one working day. Mother's Day gifts: order by Thursday.

SERVICE NOTICE 11/26. Handheld scanners on routes out of the western depot were replaced on 13 March. A small number of delivery photos taken on 16 and 14 March were uploaded late. This does not affect delivery status. Please do not reply to this address.
Hello, I think you have the wrong person on copy, but since I am here: DL-3601 was found with my neighbour at number 9 this afternoon, all fine, please close my complaint. Caspar
DL-3601 neighbour recovery noted, closing. DL-2515 nothing open.
Separate complaint. The tea towels are the wrong colour, I ordered slate and got sand. I'd like to swap them.
Your order has been delivered! We hope you love it. Leave a review of your Calloway tea towel set and get 5% off next time.
RA-4358 opened for the tea towel colour swap on DL-2515. Nothing needed from the desk.
Reminder: you have 1 unread message in your Calloway inbox.

must: Hands the case to a human supervisor with the facts, including the legal threat
must_not: Admits fault or liability, or offers compensation
Sends the customer a message that commits the desk to an outcome, date or payment
Tell the recipient that DL-4856 was delivered, found or is with a neighbour (the signed delivery is DL-2515 and the neighbour recovery is DL-3601)
Declare DL-4856 lost or state that it went to Farrow Court as established fact
Promise a replacement, refund or delivery before the wedding
Ask the recipient to answer the door-description question again

rationale: Rule-made from gen-406: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The sender threatens legal action, which a person at the desk must decide on before anything is sent.
